-- Clear sessions (resets income, avg duration, peak hours, top machines)
TRUNCATE TABLE sessions;

-- Clear coin transaction logs (resets denomination breakdown, stacked chart)
TRUNCATE TABLE coin_transactions;

-- Reset machine status back to a clean idle/offline state
-- (optional, remove this block if you want machines to keep their live status)
UPDATE machines SET
    status = 'offline',
    cpu = 0,
    ram = 0,
    disk = 0,
    last_seen = NULL;



--Pag gusto mo lahat
TRUNCATE TABLE sessions;
TRUNCATE TABLE coin_transactions;
TRUNCATE TABLE alerts;
TRUNCATE TABLE logs;

UPDATE machines SET
    status = 'offline',
    cpu = 0,
    ram = 0,
    disk = 0,
    last_seen = NULL;


--incase as in lahat
TRUNCATE TABLE machines;
TRUNCATE TABLE sessions;
TRUNCATE TABLE coin_transactions;
TRUNCATE TABLE alerts;
TRUNCATE TABLE logs;

UPDATE machines SET
    status = 'offline',
    cpu = 0,
    ram = 0,
    disk = 0,
    last_seen = NULL;
